purpose: Teach: エスカレート/傷つき/溺れ/出来上がる/先立っ/かぶせ/さかのぼっ/しゃべら

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ご近所の喧嘩がエスカレートする事もあった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, the neighbors' fights would sometimes escalate.
lines.style: Soft, almost conversational remembering. Long pause between thoughts. The weight of old memory — not sad, just present. Gaze somewhere distant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、人の心が傷つき易さを察してらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — Grandpa, you always noticed when people's hearts were easy to hurt, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with a gentle question mark in the voice. Affirming him while inviting him deeper into the memory. Patient, like she has all the time in the world.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが川で溺れる子を助けられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, my father saved a drowning child in the river.
lines.style: Same wistful weight. Slightly more present than the last — this memory has more life in it. Still looking back, but with a note of quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の工作が出来上がるまで見守られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you watched our grandchild finish their craft project without interrupting, didn't you?
lines.style: Affectionate recollection, almost playful. A small smile in her voice. Shifting the memory to him watching their grandchild — bringing him into the present moment gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが正月に先立って門松を出された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, my father would set out the pine branches before New Year's.
lines.style: Same distant, patient register. A ritual memory — smaller in emotional weight than the last, but held with the same care. Quieter attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫に布団をかぶせて寝かせて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you'd tuck our grandchild in with a blanket and help them fall asleep, didn't you?
lines.style: Tender, almost whispered at the edges. The satisfaction of a small completed kindness. Softly affirming what he's been — letting him know she sees him in their grandchild.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは家系をさかのぼって調べてらした
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, my father would research our family tree, tracing back through the generations.
lines.style: The same wistful pull, but this memory feels more deliberate — a search for something. Slightly more engaged than the others. The patience of genealogy in his voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族に静かにしゃべらず怒鳴る事もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you spoke to the family, you were gentle — you never shouted, did you?
lines.style: Quiet affection with a note of protection in it. Close, almost confidential. Affirming him for the softness he chose. A slight catch in her voice — this matters to her.
